title: Validation: allow Agent provider omitted when model is provider/model
description: Registry validation currently errors if Agent.provider is missing and there is no default_provider, even when Agent.model is in LiteLLM format like openai/gpt-4o-mini. This blocks the preferred DSL style (model includes provider) and breaks docs/books that use model=provider/model without provider=.\n\nFix: in RegistryBuilder.validate(), treat agents as having an implicit provider when model is a string in provider/model or provider:model format. Add unit tests.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria: - Agent declarations with model="openai/gpt-4o-mini" validate without provider="openai"\n- Declarations with model missing provider prefix still error when provider/default_provider are missing\n- Unit tests cover both cases
custom.beads_close_reason: RegistryBuilder.validate now accepts provider/model or provider:model agent models without provider=; added unit tests
